name: .277 Cal-118gr Hammer HBC™

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "g7-bc= .238"; the page says "calculated from shot drops at 860y, 4200′ elevation, MV of 3430 fps".
Hammer Bullets: "g1-bc= .466"; the page says "calculated from shot drops at 860y, 4200′ elevation, MV of 3430 fps".

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-10″ or faster

note: Tip length: .143″. PDR drive band spacing: .200″ (recommend two drive bands in the case neck for concentricity) Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. form factor= .925. The product page also says: "We designed this pure copper .277 caliber Hammer HBC™ to be able to run in the traditional factory 1-10″ twist barrels and be fully stable. In our factory Tikka 270 Winchester test rifle, we are running these at 3430 fps. That is in a 22″ short barrel! With a 100y zero the dial up to 860y was only 14 moa. Depending on your elevation this makes the 270 Win a max point-blank range combo on a 5″ radius kill zone out to 410y."
